product_overview: CallWaiting AI is a Next.js 14 SaaS platform that delivers AI-powered voice receptionist services for businesses. It provides real-time voice call handling with AI speech recognition, natural language understanding, and automated lead qualification to streamline customer interactions and appointment scheduling.
core_goals: Provide a seamless AI-driven voice receptionist that can manage inbound and outbound calls in real-time.
Enable accurate speech-to-text and text-to-speech conversion for natural conversation.
Offer robust user authentication, security, and payment systems for enterprise use.
Deliver a comprehensive dashboard for users to manage AI agents, monitor analytics, and control account settings.
Facilitate integration with telecommunications via Twilio and e-payment platforms such as Flutterwave.
Ensure high system reliability, security, and monitoring with rate limiting, encryption, and detailed logging.
key_features: Real-time Voice AI Receptionist leveraging Groq LLM and Deepgram STT for conversation management.
Custom Text-to-Speech service providing multiple voice options for natural responses.
Twilio integration for handling inbound/outbound calls with status tracking and transcription.
AI-powered lead extraction, qualification, and CRM integration capabilities.
Comprehensive free trial system with usage tracking and quota management.
Secure user authentication and authorization supporting email/password and OAuth flows via NextAuth.js and Supabase.
Comprehensive user dashboard for managing agents, analytics, billing, and integrations.
Embedded chat widget powered by Groq AI for real-time website messaging.
Payment processing and subscription management integrated with Flutterwave.
Enterprise-grade security features including rate limiting, API key management, encryption, and webhook signature validation.
Monitoring and logging system with health checks, structured logs, and performance metrics tracking.
Admin panel for user management and system health monitoring.
WhatsApp messaging integration for customer notifications and updates.
Extensive documentation, FAQ, and support system with AI chat assistance.
user_flow_summary: Users sign up and authenticate using email/password or OAuth through a secure flow.
Users create and configure AI voice agents with custom scripts and LLM/TTS settings.
Incoming calls via Twilio are processed in real-time using speech-to-text and Groq LLM to generate appropriate responses.
Agents can qualify leads and record data which can be delivered to integrated CRMs or stored for analysis.
Users access their dashboard to monitor agent performance, view analytics, manage billing, and configure settings.
Users can start free trials and monitor usage quotas before subscribing to paid plans via Flutterwave.
Users can embed a chat widget on their websites for AI-powered text conversations.
Administrators use dedicated panels to manage platform users, test components, and monitor system health.
validation_criteria: Voice AI receptionists reliably handle calls with accurate speech-to-text conversion and natural speech synthesis responses.
Authentication and session management function securely without unauthorized access or data leaks.
Payment processing through Flutterwave completes successfully with correct subscription status updates.
Lead extraction and qualification logic accurately identifies and scores leads for CRM delivery.
Dashboard analytics display real-time usage and correctly reflect user activity and system status.
Rate limiting and API key security prevent abuse and unauthorized API access as per configured policies.
System health monitoring services report accurate uptime, response times, and log errors for troubleshooting.
Admin panel executes management tasks correctly including user creation, testing, and status monitoring.
All integrations such as Twilio calls, Deepgram STT, Groq LLM, and Flutterwave payment function as expected.
Chat widget provides AI-based responses with low latency and proper conversational context handling.
Documentation and support systems are accessible and provide accurate, comprehensive information to users.
